thread.title: Q2 2019 EPS Estimates for Apple Inc. Reduced by KeyCorp (AAPL)

author: Steven Smith
title: Q2 2019 EPS Estimates for Apple Inc. Reduced by KeyCorp (AAPL)
text:
Posted by Steven Smith on Jan 19th, 2019 // No Comments
Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) – Stock analysts at KeyCorp cut their Q2 2019 EPS estimates for Apple in a research note issued to investors on Wednesday, January 2nd, according to Zacks Investment Research . KeyCorp analyst A. Hargreaves now forecasts that the iPhone maker will earn $2.95 per share for the quarter, down from their previous forecast of $3.06. KeyCorp also issued estimates for Apple’s Q3 2019 earnings at $2.48 EPS, Q4 2019 earnings at $2.99 EPS, FY2019 earnings at $12.63 EPS and Q3 2020 earnings at $2.76 EPS. Get Apple alerts:
AAPL has been the subject of a number of other reports. Wedbush upgraded shares of Apple to an “outperform” rating and reduced their price objective for the stock from $310.00 to $275.00 in a research note on Wednesday, November 28th. They noted that the move was a valuation call. Morgan Stanley upped their target price on shares of Apple from $226.00 to $253.00 and gave the company an “overweight” rating in a research report on Thursday, November 8th. JPMorgan Chase & Co. set a $272.00 price target on shares of Apple and gave the company a “buy” rating in a research report on Monday, October 29th. UBS Group lowered their target price on Apple from to and set a “buy” rating for the company in a research note on Monday, November 12th. Finally, Royal Bank of Canada reissued a “buy” rating and issued a $240.00 price objective on shares of Apple in a report on Monday, November 19th. Three equities research analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, twenty-five have given a hold rating and twenty-two have given a buy rating to the company. Apple has a consensus rating of “Hold” and a consensus target price of $195.19.
Shares of AAPL opened at $156.82 on Friday. Apple has a 12-month low of $142.00 and a 12-month high of $233.47. The company has a market capitalization of $761.55 billion, a PE ratio of 13.17, a price-to-earnings-growth ratio of 1.47 and a beta of 1.23. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.87, a quick ratio of 1.09 and a current ratio of 1.12.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last released its quarterly earnings results on Thursday, November 1st. The iPhone maker reported $2.91 earnings per share for the quarter, beating the Zacks’ consensus estimate of $2.78 by $0.13. The business had revenue of $62.90 billion during the quarter, compared to analyst estimates of $61.55 billion. Apple had a net margin of 22.41% and a return on equity of 48.68%. The business’s revenue was up 19.6% on a year-over-year basis. During the same period last year, the business earned $2.07 EPS.
A number of large investors have recently bought and sold shares of AAPL. Landsberg Bennett & Dubbaneh LLC purchased a new position in shares of Apple in the 4th quarter valued at $1,435,000. Truewealth LLC raised its stake in shares of Apple by 7.3% in the 4th quarter. Truewealth LLC now owns 25,973 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $4,097,000 after acquiring an additional 1,757 shares during the period. Strategic Family Wealth Counselors L.L.C. purchased a new position in shares of Apple in the 4th quarter valued at $914,000. Diversified Trust Co raised its stake in shares of Apple by 367.7% in the 4th quarter. Diversified Trust Co now owns 70,285 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $11,087,000 after acquiring an additional 55,257 shares during the period. Finally, Paragon Capital Management LLC raised its stake in shares of Apple by 16.4% in the 4th quarter. Paragon Capital Management LLC now owns 4,714 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $743,000 after acquiring an additional 664 shares during the period. 57.04% of the stock is currently owned by institutional investors.
In other Apple news, insider Chris Kondo sold 3,408 shares of the company’s stock in a transaction dated Monday, November 19th. The shares were sold at an average price of $190.00, for a total transaction of $647,520.00. Following the transaction, the insider now directly owns 8,940 shares in the company, valued at $1,698,600. The sale was disclosed in a document filed with the Securities & Exchange Commission, which is available at this link . Insiders own 0.05% of the company’s stock.
About Apple
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers. It also sells various related software, services, accessories, and third-party digital content and applications. The company offers iPhone, a line of smartphones; iPad, a line of multi-purpose tablets; and Mac, a line of desktop and portable personal computers, as well as iOS, macOS, watchOS, and tvOS operating systems.
